finding.description: The index-import path creates a const intrusive pointer and passes it as an lvalue to the sole TExprContext::ChangeChild overload, which accepts a non-const rvalue pointer reference.
finding.repair: Make the local pointer movable and move it into its only consuming ChangeChild call.
finding.ownership_review: The pointer is local, used only at this call after initialization, and the reconstructed expression retains the moved child; no later read or mutation of the moved local occurs.

other_source_checks: NOpt::KqpRewriteIndexRead is declared in NKikimr::NKqp::NOpt and accepts a const TKqpOptimizeContext reference matching RewriteSelect.
The RBO library already links the logical optimizer library; no new PEERDIR is required for the lowering helper.
TKqpReadTableSettings has Parse overloads for read-ranges base nodes and name/value settings lists, and exposes ItemsLimit, IsSorted and IsReverse used by the new import/export code.
ExistingTable is already called with Table().Path() in existing logical and nearby RBO code.
The extended TOpRead constructor signature and initializer order match all changed reconstruction/copy call sites.
TOpTableLookup copy code accesses its own private Columns member and existing public plain-lookup state; lookup key and column container APIs match declarations.
The first ChangeChild receives a temporary new-list pointer and already matches the consuming API.
The trailing optional IndexRead expression node child and builder/import calls follow the existing optional-child node schema pattern.
limitations: Source review does not prove this is the only build failure; root must rerun the actual guarded build.
